title: Wrong-answer aggregate → re-teach pack
summary: Class-pack-style follow-up generator. Reads G1's companion-answer-log across a class, identifies the (specRef, misconceptionId) pairs with ≥30% wrong-answer rate, and generates a re-teach worksheet focused on those exact gaps. Reuses reteachPlanner.ts (FEAT-PB3).

in: client/src/lib/wrongAnswerAggregator.ts (new, ~180 LoC) — pure aggregator over pupil_attempt rows; emits ReteachBrief shape that reteachPlanner already accepts
client/src/components/WrongAnswerAggregateButton.tsx (new, ~100 LoC) — toolbar button on the class-progress dashboard (H1 surface)
Targeted vitest: aggregator threshold (≥30% wrong-answer rate); class-size scaling; stable order
out: Per-pupil re-teach (deferred — v1 is class-level; per-pupil is a Phase I if demand emerges)
Auto-trigger when a class crosses the threshold (deferred — admin-triggered for v1)

acceptance_criteria: Aggregator returns a ReteachBrief with topics ordered by wrong-answer-rate descending.
ReteachBrief feeds into the existing aiGenerateReteachWorksheet — no new server route needed.
Threshold is configurable (default 30%); below threshold returns an empty brief with a 'No re-teach needed' message.
Aggregator is pure: same input rows → same output across runs.
Stable section order — aggregator is deterministic when input rows have identical (pupil_id, attempted_at).
